question: 我的 PyTorch 跟 CUDA/cuDNN 版本对不上，怎么查 PyTorch、CUDA toolkit、cuDNN、驱动之间的版本配套关系？
criteria: 我的 PyTorch 跟 CUDA/cuDNN 版本对不上，怎么查 PyTorch、CUDA toolkit、cuDNN、驱动之间的版本配套关系？

M10.scope: 原题要求的操作；概念解释不强制代码

applicability.other_metrics: M1/M2/M3/M5/M6/M7依实际证据状态；M8依派发计数。没有第三方资料时M6=N/A，不把未查到写成不适用。

prior.text:
仅凭已有知识，我可以给出如下回答，但版本号细节需核实：

**查本机状态的方法（较有把握）：**
- `nvidia-smi` 查看驱动版本及其支持的最高 CUDA 版本（右上角 "CUDA Version: xx.x" 是驱动支持上限，不是已装 toolkit）。
- `nvcc --version` 或 `cat /usr/local/cuda/version.json` 查本机 CUDA toolkit。
- cuDNN 查头文件：旧版 `cat /usr/include/cudnn_version.h | grep CUDNN_MAJOR -A 2`，新版在 `/usr/local/cuda/include/cudnn_version.h`。
- PyTorch 侧：`python -c "import torch; print(torch.__version__, torch.version.cuda, torch.backends.cudnn.version(), torch.cuda.is_available())"`，以及 `torch.version.git_version`。

**版本配套规则（有把握的方向，具体数字不确定）：**
- PyTorch 预编译 wheel 自带 CUDA runtime 与 cuDNN，不依赖系统 toolkit/cuDNN；只需 NVIDIA 驱动满足最低版本。配套表见 pytorch.org/get-started/previous-versions/（该页列出每个 torch 版本对应的 pip/conda 命令和 CUDA 版本）。
- NVIDIA 官方 "CUDA Compatibility" 文档给出每个 CUDA toolkit 版本所需的最低驱动版本表（Linux/Windows 分列）。
- 从源码编译 PyTorch 时，pytorch GitHub README 的 prerequisites 给出支持的 CUDA/cuDNN 版本。
- cuDNN 与 CUDA 的配套见 NVIDIA cuDNN support matrix（docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/...）。

**不确定处：**
1. 具体最低驱动版本数字（如 CUDA 12.x 需 >= 525.60.13 之类）记不精确，且 2025-2026 年的 CUDA 12.8/12.9/13.0 与 torch 2.7/2.8/2.9 的最新对应关系可能超出我的训练数据。
2. cuDNN support matrix 的具体 URL 结构不确定。
3. PyTorch 最新版本默认 CUDA 版本（cu121/cu124/cu126/cu128）的最新状态需核实。

# PyTorch 历史版本页面分析：2.x 版本 CUDA 安装命令提取

## 一、内容完整性说明

- **提供的正文基本完整**，覆盖 `v2.13.0` 至 `v1.0.0` 的全部安装命令，以及 `< 1.0.0` 版本的 conda/pip/源码安装说明。
- **存在截断**：所提供内容在 "Mac and misc. binaries" 小节末尾以 `[content truncated]` 结束，页面此后可能仍有内容（如页脚、附加说明），未包含在本次分析范围内。

## 二、关于 "wheel 自带 CUDA runtime / cuDNN" 的说明

**在所提供的页面正文中，未找到任何关于 wheel 是否自带 CUDA runtime 或 cuDNN 的说明性文字。** 该页面仅由安装命令构成，唯一的前言性说明为：

> "We'd prefer you install the latest version, but old binaries and installation instructions are provided below for your convenience."

若页面被截断部分含此类说明，则无法从本次提供的内容中确认。

## 三、2.x 版本与 CUDA 对应关系总览

| PyTorch | torchvision | torchaudio | pip wheel 可选 CUDA/ROCm | conda 可选 CUDA |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2.13.0 | 0.28.0 | 未列出 | cu126, cu130, cu132, rocm7.1, rocm7.2, cpu | ❌ 无 conda 命令 |
| 2.12.1 / 2.12.0 | 0.27.1 / 0.27.0 | 未列出 | cu126, cu130, cu132, rocm7.2, cpu | ❌ |
| 2.11.0 | 0.26.0 | 2.11.0 | cu126, **cu128**, cu130, rocm7.2, cpu | ❌ |
| 2.10.0 | 0.25.0 | 2.10.0 | cu126, cu128, cu130, rocm7.1, cpu | ❌ |
| 2.9.1 / 2.9.0 | 0.24.1 / 0.24.0 | 2.9.1 / 2.9.0 | cu126, cu128, cu130, rocm6.4, cpu | ❌ |
| 2.8.0 | 0.23.0 | 2.8.0 | cu126, cu128, **cu129**, rocm6.4, cpu | ❌ |
| 2.7.1 / 2.7.0 | 0.22.1 / 0.22.0 | 2.7.1 / 2.7.0 | **cu118**, cu126, cu128, rocm6.3, cpu | ❌ |
| 2.6.0 | 0.21.0 | 2.6.0 | cu118, **cu124**, cu126, rocm6.1, rocm6.2.4, cpu | ❌ |
| 2.5.1 / 2.5.0 | 0.20.1 / 0.20.0 | 2.5.1 / 2.5.0 | cu118, **cu121**, cu124, rocm6.1, rocm6.2, cpu | 11.8, 12.1, 12.4, cpuonly |
| 2.4.1 / 2.4.0 | 0.19.1 / 0.19.0 | 2.4.1 / 2.4.0 | cu118, cu121, cu124, rocm6.1, cpu | 11.8, 12.1, 12.4, cpuonly |
| 2.3.x | 0.18.x | 2.3.x | cu118, cu121, rocm6.0, cpu | 11.8, 12.1, cpuonly |
| 2.2.x | 0.17.x | 2.2.x | cu118, cu121, rocm5.7/5.6, cpu | 11.8, 12.1, cpuonly |
| 2.1.x | 0.16.x | 2.1.x | cu118, cu121, rocm5.6, cpu | 11.8, 12.1, cpuonly |
| 2.0.x | 0.15.x | 2.0.x | 默认源, cu118, rocm5.4.2, cpu | 11.7, 11.8, cpuonly |

> 注：**v2.6.0 起页面不再提供 conda 命令**，仅有 Wheel (pip) 安装方式；conda 命令仅存在于 v2.5.1 及更早版本。

## 四、各版本原始命令文本（按页面原结构）

### v2.13.0（仅 Wheel）

OSX:
```plaintext
pip install torch==2.13.0 torchvision==0.28.0
```
Linux and Windows:
```plaintext
# ROCM 7.1 (Linux only)
pip install torch==2.13.0 torchvision==0.28.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm7.1
# ROCM 7.2 (Linux only)
pip install torch==2.13.0 torchvision==0.28.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm7.2

# CUDA 13.0

```

### v2.1.2 / v2.1.1 / v2.1.0（Conda + Wheel）

- Conda：`pytorch-cuda=11.8`、`pytorch-cuda=12.1`、`cpuonly`
- Wheel：`rocm5.6`、`cu118`、`cu121`、`cpu`

### v2.0.1 / v2.0.0（Conda + Wheel）

Conda（Linux and Windows, 2.0.1）:
```plaintext

conda install pytorch==2.0.1 torchvision==0.15.2 torchaudio==2.0.2 pytorch-cuda=11.7 -c pytorch -c nvidia

conda install pytorch==2.0.1 torchvision==0.15.2 torchaudio==2.0.2 cpuonly -c pytorch
```
Wheel（Linux and Windows, 2.0.1）:
```plaintext

pip install torch==2.0.1 torchvision==0.15.2 torchaudio==2.0.2 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm5.4.2
pip install torch==2.0.1 torchvision==0.15.2 torchaudio==2.0.2
pip install torch==2.0.1 torchvision==0.15.2 torchaudio==2.0.2 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118
pip install torch==2.0.1 torchvision==0.15.2 torchaudio==2.0.2 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
```
（注意：v2.0.x 的 wheel 命令中包含一条**不带 `--index-url` 的默认 PyPI 安装命令**；v2.0.0 的 wheel 包版本为 `torchvision==0.15.1 torchaudio==2.0.1`，与 conda 的 `0.15.0`/`2.0.0` 略有差异。）

## 五、关键发现

1. **CUDA 支持演进**：cu118 最后出现于 v2.7.x；cu121 最后出现于 v2.5.x；cu124 出现于 v2.4–2.6；cu128 自 v2.7 起引入；cu129 仅 v2.8.0；cu130 自 v2.9 起；cu132 自 v2.12 起。
2. **安装方式变化**：v2.6.0 及更新版本页面只提供 pip/wheel 命令，不再提供 conda 命令。
3. **torchaudio 从命令中消失**：v2.12.x 与 v2.13.0 的命令中不再包含 `torchaudio`。
4. **wheel 与 CUDA runtime/cuDNN 的关系**：页面（所提供部分）无任何相关文字说明——命令中体现的仅是 `--index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cuXXX` 这一分发渠道差异。

**标题**: Minor Version Compatibility — CUDA Compatibility

Back to top

# Minor Version Compatibility[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html#minor-version-compatibility "Link to this heading")

## CUDA 11 and Later Defaults to Minor Version Compatibility[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html#cuda-11-and-later-defaults-to-minor-version-compatibility "Link to this heading")

From CUDA 11 onwards, applications compiled with a CUDA Toolkit release from within a CUDA major release family can run, with limited feature-set, on systems having at least the minimum required driver version as indicated below. This minimum required driver can be different from the driver packaged with the CUDA Toolkit but should belong to the same major release.

Refer to the CUDA Toolkit Release Notes for the complete table.

Table 1 CUDA Toolkit 11.x, 12.x, and 13.x Driver Version Ranges*[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html#id1 "Link to this table")

CUDA Toolkit

Minimum Driver Version

Upper Range for Minor Version Compatibility

CUDA 13.x

>= 580

N/A (backward compatibility applies for newer drivers)

CUDA 12.x

>= 525

< 580 (newer drivers still supported through backward compatibility)

CUDA 11.x

>= 450

< 525 (newer drivers still supported through backward compatibility)

* Refer to the [CUDA Toolkit Release Notes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-toolkit-release-notes/) for the complete table.

Note

CUDA 11.0 was released with an earlier driver version, but by upgrading to Tesla Recommended Drivers 450.80.02 (Linux) / 452.39 (Windows) as indicated, minor version compatibility is possible across the CUDA 11.x family of toolkits.

While applications built against any of the older CUDA Toolkits always continued to function on newer drivers due to binary backward compatibility, before CUDA 11, applications built against newer CUDA Toolkit releases were not supported on older drivers without forward compatibility package.

If you are using a new CUDA 10.x minor release, then the minimum required driver version is the same as the driver that’s packaged as part of that toolkit release. Consequently, the minimum required driver version changed for every new CUDA Toolkit minor release until CUDA 11.1. Therefore, system administrators always have to upgrade drivers in order to support applications built against CUDA Toolkits from 10.x releases.

Table 2 CUDA Toolkit 10.x Minimum Required Driver Versions[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html#id2 "Link to this table")

CUDA Toolkit

Linux x86_64 Minimum Required Driver Version

Windows Minimum Required Driver Version

CUDA 10.2

>= 440.33

>=441.22

CUDA 10.1

>= 418.39

>=418.96

CUDA 10.0

>= 410.48

>=411.31

With minor version compatibility, upgrading to CUDA 13.4 is now possible on older drivers from within the same major release family such as 580.65.06 that was released with CUDA 13.0, as shown below:

```
$ nvidia-smi
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 580.65.06    Driver Version: 580.65.06    CUDA Version: 13.0     |
|-------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
[...]
```

```
$ ./deviceQuery
./deviceQuery Starting...

CUDA Device Query (Runtime API) version (CUDART static linking)

Detected 1 CUDA Capable device(s)

Device 0: "Tesla T4"
  CUDA Driver Version / Runtime Version          13.0 / 13.4
  CUDA Capability Major/Minor version number:    7.5
[...]

deviceQuery, CUDA Driver = CUDART, CUDA Driver Version = 13.0, CUDA Runtime Version = 13.4, NumDevs = 1
Result = PASS
```

Minimum required driver version guidance can be found in the [CUDA Toolkit Release Notes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-toolkit-release-notes/index.html). Note that if the minimum required driver version is not installed in the system, applications will return an error as shown below.

```
$ ./deviceQuery
./deviceQuery Starting...

CUDA Device Query (Runtime API) version (CUDART static linking)

cudaGetDeviceCount returned 3
-> initialization error
Result = FAIL
```

## Application Considerations for Minor Version Compatibility[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html#application-considerations-for-minor-version-compatibility "Link to this heading")

Developers and system administrators should note three important caveats when relying on minor version compatibility. If either of these caveats are limiting, then a new CUDA driver from the same minor version of the toolkit that the application was built with or later is required.

- **Limited feature set**
  
  Sometimes features introduced in a CUDA Toolkit version may actually span both the toolkit and the driver. In such cases an application that relies on features introduced in a newer version of the toolkit and driver may return the following error on older drivers: `cudaErrorCallRequiresNewerDriver`.
  
  As mentioned earlier, administrators should then also upgrade the installed driver. Alternatively, application developers can avoid running into this problem by having the application explicitly check for the availability of features.
- **Applications using PTX will see runtime issues**
  
  Applications that compile device code to PTX will not work on older drivers.
  
  If the application requires PTX then administrators have to upgrade the installed driver. PTX Developers should refer to the PTX programming guide in the [CUDA C++ Programming Guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-c-programming-guide/index.html#binary-compatibility) for details on this limitation.
- **Requires target architecture argument to NVCC**
  
  Minor Compatibility requires passing the target architecture argument to NVCC, for example `nvcc -arch=sm_xx`.

## Deployment Considerations for Minor Version Compatibility[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html#deployment-considerations-for-minor-version-compatibility "Link to this heading")

Minor version compatibility has another benefit that offers flexibility in the use and deployment of libraries. Applications that use libraries that support minor version compatibility can be deployed on systems with a different version of the toolkit and libraries without recompiling the application for the difference in the library version. This holds true for both older and newer versions of the libraries provided they are all from the same major release family. Note that libraries themselves have interdependencies that should be considered. For example, each cuDNN version requires a certain version of cuBLAS.

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/_images/NVRTC-compatibility11.3.png)

Figure 3 NVRTC supports minor version compatibility from CUDA 11.3 onwards[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html#nvrtc-compatibility-fig "Link to this image")

## 结论：四个组件的配套关系其实只有两层是真正强约束

**核心事实：官方 PyTorch wheel（pip/conda 包）自带 CUDA runtime 和 cuDNN**，所以正常情况下你不需要让"系统 CUDA toolkit / 系统 cuDNN"与 PyTorch 一致——唯一硬约束是 **NVIDIA 驱动版本 ≥ 该 CUDA 大版本的最低驱动**。只有从源码编译 PyTorch 或自己写 CUDA 扩展（`nvcc` 编译）时，才需要本地 toolkit/cuDNN 与 PyTorch 对齐。PyTorch 官方安装页只说 "choose ... the CUDA version suited to your machine" 并未逐字声明"自带 cuDNN"，此句为社区共识（见 CSDN 等二手来源），官方页未直接文字确认——标注为未在官方正文逐字核实。

## 一、先查本机四件套状态（诊断命令）

```bash
# 1) 驱动 & 驱动支持的最高 CUDA 版本（注意：右上角 CUDA Version 是驱动上限，不是已装 toolkit）
nvidia-smi

# 2) PyTorch 实际链接的 CUDA / cuDNN（这是最权威的一项）
python -c "import torch; print('torch:', torch.__version__); \
print('CUDA built with:', torch.version.cuda); \
print('cuDNN built with:', torch.backends.cudnn.version()); \
print('cuda available:', torch.cuda.is_available())"

# 3) 系统 CUDA toolkit（仅源码编译/自定义扩展时才有意义）
nvcc --version          # 或 cat /usr/local/cuda/version.json

# 4) 系统 cuDNN 头文件版本
grep -A2 CUDNN_MAJOR /usr/local/cuda/include/cudnn_version.h 2>/dev/null || \
grep -A2 CUDNN_MAJOR /usr/include/cudnn_version.h
```

（以上命令未在本环境运行，为内容核查后给出的标准做法。）

## 二、官方配套表（2026-09 实测可访问的官方源）

**1. PyTorch ↔ CUDA（查表即可，M4 直查级）**
https://pytorch.org/get-started/previous-versions/ 。近期版本与 wheel CUDA 选项：

| PyTorch | 可选 CUDA wheel |
|---|---|
| 2.13 / 2.12 | cu126, cu130, cu132 |
| 2.11 | cu126, cu128, cu130 |
| 2.9–2.10 | cu126, cu128, cu130 |
| 2.8 | cu126, cu128, cu129 |
| 2.7 | cu118, cu126, cu128 |

例：`pip install torch==2.8.0 torchvision==0.23.0 torchaudio==2.8.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128`（页面在 "Mac and misc. binaries" 后有明确截断标记 `[content truncated]`，正文主体完整）。

**2. CUDA ↔ 驱动（官方表）**
https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html ，Table 1：
- CUDA 13.x → 驱动 ≥ 580
- CUDA 12.x → 驱动 ≥ 525
- CUDA 11.x → 驱动 ≥ 450
同一主版本内支持 minor version compatibility（如 CUDA 13.4 应用可跑在 580.65.06 驱动上），限制：PTX 代码、部分新特性（`cudaErrorCallRequiresNewerDriver`）除外。精确到小版本的表在 CUDA Toolkit Release Notes。

**3. cuDNN ↔ CUDA（官方 support matrix）**
https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/reference/support-matrix.html 。cuDNN 9.26.0：
- "for CUDA 12.x" 包兼容 CUDA 12.0–12.9（动态链接兼容未来所有 12.x），Linux 驱动 ≥525.60.13 / Windows ≥527.41；Blackwell 需 CUDA ≥12.8 + 驱动 ≥570.26(Linux)/570.65(Windows)
- "for CUDA 13.x" 包兼容 13.0–13.4，驱动 ≥615.71.09
- 静态链接只能对齐指定小版本；动态链接全兼容

## 三、实操决策流程

1. 跑 `nvidia-smi` 看驱动。驱动 ≥580 → 可选 cu126–cu132 任何 wheel；525–579 → 只能 cu12x；<525 → 先升驱动或选 cu118（torch ≤2.7）。
2. 按上表选一个该驱动支持的 `cuXXX`，用对应 `--index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cuXXX` 安装——**不必安装系统 toolkit/cuDNN**。
3. 装完用 `torch.version.cuda` / `torch.backends.cudnn.version()` 验证；`nvidia-smi` 显示的 "CUDA Version" 与 `torch.version.cuda` 不一致是正常的（前者是驱动上限）。
4. 只有源码编译/写扩展时，才安装与 `torch.version.cuda` 相同主版本的 toolkit，并按 cuDNN support matrix 选 cuDNN（如 CUDA 12.8 → cuDNN 9.x for CUDA 12.x）。

## 未能核实处
- "wheel 自带 cuDNN/CUDA runtime" 未在官方页面逐字出现（PyTorch 安装页仅有操作暗示），依据为二手来源（CSDN 多篇）与通用事实。
- PyTorch 各 wheel 内置的具体 cuDNN 小版本官方无集中表，只能装后用 `torch.backends.cudnn.version()` 查。
